entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working correctly and I'd like a refund.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate tracking is completely off. I'll be sitting still and it says my heart rate is 150. The data is just garbage.

I'm sorry to hear you're having that trouble. That definitely doesn't sound right. I can see you received the band about 15 days ago. For a technical issue like this, our first step is to connect you with our tech support team to verify the fault. They have a few quick troubleshooting steps we can try.
No, I'm not interested in that. I just don't have time to sit on the phone troubleshooting. I've already tried restarting it and all that. I just want my money back.

I understand you're busy. The verification with tech support is a required step for us to process a return for a defect outside the initial return window. Without it, we can't confirm the hardware issue.
Listen, the product is defective. I don't want to troubleshoot, I don't want a replacement, I just want a refund. It's that simple.

I see. Here is the situation: the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy for any reason. Since you are on day 15, any return must be processed as a warranty claim for a verified defect. Because you're declining the mandatory verification step with our technical team, I'm unable to approve the return.

Okay. I hear what you're saying about the 10-day policy. I get it, rules are rules. But the device isn't working as advertised. So, a full refund is off the table. I can accept that. How about we meet in the middle? A 50% store credit?

I appreciate you trying to find a compromise, but my hands are tied here. The policy is firm, especially for the VeloBand, due to hygiene protocols and how the device links to a user account upon activation. I am not authorized to offer partial credits for this situation.
No partial credit? Not even a discount code for a future purchase? I've been a VeloFit customer for years. There has to be something you can do.

I truly wish there were, and I do value your loyalty. However, I can't override the system on this. The only alternative I can suggest for an unwanted device outside the return policy is our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. You could list it there for other users.
So your best offer is for me to sell your broken product to someone else? That doesn't seem right.

I understand your perspective. It is the only option available for returns that are out-of-policy and where the defect cannot be verified by our team. I do apologize that we couldn't reach a more favorable outcome for you.
Right. Well, I guess that's that. Thanks for your time.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that'll be all.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
